bugs.title: Task creation accepts an empty title
bugs.description: The new-task form marks the title input `required`, but the server never checks for a non-empty title, so a direct POST (or a client with JavaScript/HTML validation disabled) creates a blank task.

bugs.title: Status filter on the task list has no effect
bugs.description: Selecting a status in the filter dropdown and submitting always renders the full, unfiltered task list; the `status` query parameter is read but never applied.

bugs.title: Editing a task's assignee never saves
bugs.description: The edit dialog's assignee field is named `assignedTo`, but the update handler reads `assignee`, a field the form never sends, so the assignee silently never changes.

bugs.title: Deleting a task reports success without deleting it
bugs.description: The delete action redirects to a "Task deleted" confirmation, but never removes the task from the in-memory list; it still appears in the task list and at its own detail page.

bugs.title: Any authenticated user can view the admin user list
bugs.description: The "Admin" navigation link is hidden from employees, but the route itself only checks that a session exists, not that the user holds the admin role. Navigating to /admin/users directly bypasses the intended restriction.

bugs.title: Password field has no accessible label association
bugs.description: The "Password" label has no `for` attribute and the password input has no `id`, so assistive technology cannot associate the label with the field.

bugs.title: Dashboard greeting is always empty
bugs.description: The dashboard template reads `user.name`, a field the User type never declares, instead of `user.displayName`. EJS renders a missing value as an empty string, so every account's greeting reads "Welcome, " with no name.

bugs.title: Sorting by priority orders by label text, not severity
bugs.description: The "Sort by priority" link compares the priority strings alphabetically ("high", "low", "medium") instead of by actual severity rank, so a medium-priority task appears after low-priority ones.

bugs.title: Editing a task deleted in another tab creates a duplicate
bugs.description: If a task is deleted (see BUG-004) or otherwise missing when its edit dialog is submitted, the handler does not report an error; it silently creates a new task from the stale form data instead.

bugs.title: CSRF token is generated but never verified
bugs.description: Every state-changing form includes a hidden CSRF token rendered from the session, but no route handler checks it against the submitted value, so the protection is decorative.

bugs.title: Edit dialog's close button has no accessible name
bugs.description: The dialog's close control is an icon-only button ("×") with no `aria-label`, so a screen reader announces only "button" with no indication of what it does.

bugs.title: Session cookie is missing the HttpOnly flag
bugs.description: The session cookie is configured with `httpOnly: false`, making it readable from client-side script and increasing the impact of any script-injection vulnerability.
